projectDescription: The official handbook for Networkerlc's high-ranking team members, covering policies, quotas, tasks, and operational guides.
keyFeatures: Role-based quota system for Management, Operations, and Executives
Ticket handling protocols for support and management tickets
Promotion policies with rank cooldowns and member caps
Review Board process for staff accountability
Weekly task assignments for Community Management and Staff Supervision

Guide: Reviewing — organizing dates, assembling Review Board, conducting the review
